build.recipe: rgbasm -o <work>/banking.o fixtures/cgb-banking/banking.asm && rgblink -n <work>/banking.sym -o <work>/banking.gb <work>/banking.o && cp <work>/banking.gb <work>/banking-cgb.gb && cp <work>/banking.gb <work>/banking-dmg.gb && rgbfix -c -v -p 0 <work>/banking-cgb.gb && rgbfix -v -p 0 <work>/banking-dmg.gb
build.committed_bytes_toolchain: RGBDS v1.0.1 macOS release archive (digest above); the reproduction script rebuilds both ROMs with the pinned tools and compares byte for byte

profile.name: CGB-CPU-E and DMG-CPU-B
profile.applicability: Original software banking fixture for the deterministic bootless CGB-CPU-E profile (CGB mode and compatibility mode) and, for banking-dmg.gb and the negative control, the DMG-CPU-B profile; not physical hardware evidence.

protocol.markers: WRAM C000=0xA5 is pass, 0xEE is fail; the guest then halts with interrupts disabled.
protocol.result_bytes: C001 run kind. C003 SVBK cell. Each cell byte is 0x01 pass, 0xFF fail, 0x00 not run.

evidence_class: original software fixture plus synthetic oracle, not hardware evidence
scope_limits: No boot-ROM execution and no CGB boot palette table
No physical CGB or DMG hardware observation; expectations come from Pan Docs and the project's own decisions D-09, D-10, D-15 and D-16
Cartridge and E0-FF OAM DMA source cells are labelled PANDOCS or ORACLE_SAMEBOY in docs/cgb-profile.md, never hardware
No CGB-E specific claim beyond the project's CGB-CPU-E profile model
Not installed and not part of the install allowlist
